name: Fire Lightning

features.name: Sticky free spins wilds
features.description: Wilds stick until the bonus ends.

features.name: Card gamble
features.description: Optional colour or suit guess after wins.

review:
A 2018 classic on 20 lines. Wilds land on the middle three reels, and three scatters anywhere give 10 free spins, which can retrigger.

In the bonus, every wild sticks until the end, so line wins can repeat spin after spin. There's a card gamble after base-game wins. Medium-high volatility with a 1,706x max and free spins about once every 157 spins. The 93.75% RTP is one of the lowest we list, so play it for nostalgia, in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
